crossRefs.note: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.
He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk…
For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

translations.web: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
translations.bsb: Young lions go lacking and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.
translations.kjv: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good
translations.asv: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger; But they that seek Jehovah shall not want any good thing.
